description: Convoy Defence: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: A freighter convoy runs through {system} and pirates know it. {client} pays you to escort it past the usual ambush. Expect fighters first, then something bigger.
Pirates are working the lane through {system}. Take a convoy through it. Do not stop for anyone who hails you.
{client} has ships to move and nobody wants to pay the pirates' toll. Escort the convoy to the exit gate.
success: The convoy passes. {client} pays {captain} and the freighter crews thank you in what they claim is their own words.
No cargo lost. {client} pays the fee in full.
The convoy is through. {client} pays and suggests you keep the lane in mind.
failure: The convoy is wrecked. {client} bills you for the cargo.
Too many freighters are lost. {client} pays nothing.
radio-convoy: Convoy to escort. Five of us, one gate. Please stay close.
Freighters ready. We are slow. We have always been slow.
Convoy Master to escort. Let us go before they see us.
radio-toll: Pirates ahead, fighters. They want a toll. Give them lead.
Ahead, five pirates. They will go for the biggest freighter.
Contact. They are asking for payment. Refuse.
radio-boarders: Gunships behind us. They want to board. Stop them.
Boarders. Two gunships. Hit them before they close.
Pirate gunships on the stern. Freighters, keep moving.
radio-boss: A pirate frigate on the right. It is the one that has been running this lane.
Frigate. Old but armed. Do not let it get a clear shot at the convoy.
Pirate frigate approaching. This is the boss.
